title: Turn off when VPN, parental control, or enterprise policies are active
description: Learn when Oasis automatically turns off secure DNS to respect VPN connections, parental controls, enterprise policies, and network requirements for optimal compatibility and compliance.
content:
Oasis intelligently manages secure DNS settings to ensure compatibility with VPN connections, parental controls, enterprise policies, and network requirements. When these systems are active, Oasis will automatically turn off secure DNS to maintain functionality and respect network configurations.

Oasis Feature

Oasis includes intelligent secure DNS management built on Firefox core technology. This feature automatically adjusts DNS settings to ensure compatibility with VPNs, parental controls, enterprise policies, and network requirements.

When Oasis Turns Off Secure DNS

Oasis automatically disables secure DNS in specific situations to ensure compatibility and respect network policies:

1

VPN Connections

When you're connected to a VPN, Oasis will turn off secure DNS to prevent conflicts with the VPN's DNS settings and ensure proper routing through the VPN tunnel.

2

Parental Controls

If parental control software is active on your device, Oasis will disable secure DNS to allow the parental control system to properly filter and monitor internet access.

3

Enterprise Policies

In corporate or enterprise environments, Oasis will respect organizational DNS policies and turn off secure DNS when enterprise network controls are active.

4

Network Requirements

When a network explicitly tells Oasis it shouldn't use secure DNS, the browser will automatically comply to maintain network compatibility.

VPN Compatibility

Why Secure DNS is Disabled

VPN connections require specific DNS routing to function properly. When you connect to a VPN, Oasis automatically turns off secure DNS to:

  • Prevent DNS leaks through the VPN tunnel
  • Ensure proper DNS resolution through the VPN
  • Maintain VPN security and privacy
  • Avoid conflicts with VPN DNS settings
  • Preserve VPN functionality

VPN Benefits Maintained

Even with secure DNS disabled, your VPN connection still provides:

  • Encrypted internet traffic
  • IP address masking
  • Geographic location spoofing
  • Network traffic protection
  • Enhanced privacy and security

Parental Control Integration

Automatic Detection

  • Detects active parental control software
  • Identifies content filtering systems
  • Recognizes monitoring applications
  • Adapts to family safety features
  • Maintains parental control effectiveness

Compatibility Benefits

  • Ensures proper content filtering
  • Maintains monitoring capabilities
  • Preserves family safety features
  • Allows parental oversight
  • Supports family protection tools

Enterprise Policy Compliance

Organizational Requirements

In enterprise environments, organizations often have specific DNS policies and security requirements. Oasis automatically complies with these policies by:

  • Detecting enterprise network configurations
  • Respecting organizational DNS settings
  • Following corporate security policies
  • Maintaining network compliance
  • Supporting enterprise security tools

Enterprise Benefits

By respecting enterprise policies, Oasis ensures:

  • Compliance with corporate security standards
  • Integration with enterprise monitoring tools
  • Support for organizational DNS infrastructure
  • Maintenance of corporate network security
  • Compatibility with enterprise applications

Network Communication

Oasis communicates with networks to understand DNS requirements:

1

Network Detection

Oasis automatically detects when a network has specific DNS requirements or restrictions that need to be respected.

2

Policy Compliance

When a network indicates that secure DNS should not be used, Oasis will automatically disable secure DNS to maintain network compatibility.

3

Automatic Adaptation

Oasis adapts its DNS behavior based on network requirements while maintaining other privacy and security features.

Privacy Protection Maintained

Other Privacy Features

Even when secure DNS is disabled, Oasis continues to provide privacy protection through:

  • Enhanced Tracking Protection
  • Cookie management
  • Fingerprinting protection
  • Social media blocking
  • Cross-site tracking prevention

Security Features

Security protections remain active including:

  • HTTPS-Only Mode
  • Deceptive content protection
  • Dangerous software blocking
  • Connection upgrades
  • Certificate management

Automatic Re-enabling

Oasis will automatically re-enable secure DNS when:

1

VPN Disconnection

When you disconnect from a VPN, Oasis will automatically re-enable secure DNS to restore maximum privacy protection.

2

Parental Control Deactivation

If parental control software is disabled, Oasis will restore secure DNS functionality.

3

Network Changes

When you connect to a different network that allows secure DNS, Oasis will automatically enable it.

4

Policy Updates

If enterprise policies change to allow secure DNS, Oasis will automatically adapt.

Manual Override Options

Advanced Settings

In some cases, you may want to manually control secure DNS settings:

  • Override automatic detection
  • Force secure DNS on specific networks
  • Customize DNS provider selection
  • Configure manual DNS settings
  • Set up custom DNS preferences

Considerations

Manual overrides should be used carefully:

  • May cause compatibility issues
  • Could break VPN functionality
  • Might violate network policies
  • Could affect parental controls
  • May impact enterprise compliance

Monitoring and Status

Current Status

  • Check if secure DNS is active
  • View current DNS provider
  • Monitor automatic changes
  • Verify compatibility status
  • Check network requirements

Detection Information

  • VPN connection status
  • Parental control detection
  • Enterprise policy compliance
  • Network DNS requirements
  • Automatic adaptation history

Common Scenarios

Home Network with VPN

When using a VPN at home, Oasis will automatically disable secure DNS to ensure proper VPN functionality while maintaining other privacy protections.

Family Computer

On a family computer with parental controls, Oasis will disable secure DNS to allow proper content filtering and monitoring while maintaining other security features.

Work Environment

In a corporate environment, Oasis will respect enterprise DNS policies and disable secure DNS to maintain compliance with organizational security requirements.

Public Network

On networks that require specific DNS settings, Oasis will automatically adapt to maintain connectivity while preserving other privacy features.

Benefits of Automatic Management

Compatibility

  • Seamless VPN integration
  • Parental control support
  • Enterprise policy compliance
  • Network requirement adaptation
  • Automatic conflict resolution

User Experience

  • No manual configuration required
  • Automatic adaptation to changes
  • Seamless network transitions
  • Maintained functionality
  • Reduced troubleshooting

Troubleshooting

Common Issues

  • Secure DNS not working
  • VPN connection problems
  • Parental control conflicts
  • Enterprise policy issues
  • Network compatibility problems

Solutions

  • Check automatic detection status
  • Verify network requirements
  • Update browser to latest version
  • Clear browser cache and cookies
  • Contact network administrator

Best Practices

Compatibility Recommendations

  • Allow automatic DNS management
  • Trust Oasis's detection capabilities
  • Respect network requirements
  • Maintain VPN functionality
  • Support parental control systems

Privacy Guidelines

  • Understand privacy trade-offs
  • Monitor other privacy features
  • Use VPNs when appropriate
  • Configure parental controls properly
  • Follow enterprise policies

What to Expect

With automatic secure DNS management, you can expect:

Automatic Behavior

  • Seamless VPN integration
  • Parental control compatibility
  • Enterprise policy compliance
  • Network requirement adaptation
  • Automatic re-enabling when appropriate

Privacy Protection

  • Maintained privacy features
  • Other security protections active
  • VPN privacy benefits preserved
  • Enhanced tracking protection
  • Comprehensive security coverage

Getting Help

For detailed instructions on managing secure DNS settings and understanding when Oasis automatically turns off secure DNS, visit Mozilla's official support guide:

Mozilla Secure DNS Management Guide

Technical Details

Oasis's automatic secure DNS management uses advanced detection and adaptation technologies:

How Automatic Management Works

  • VPN Detection: Automatically detects active VPN connections and adjusts DNS settings accordingly
  • Parental Control Recognition: Identifies active parental control software and adapts DNS behavior
  • Enterprise Policy Compliance: Detects corporate network requirements and follows organizational policies
  • Network Communication: Communicates with networks to understand DNS requirements and restrictions
  • Automatic Adaptation: Seamlessly switches between secure DNS and compatible DNS settings as needed

Since Oasis is built on Firefox core technology, this intelligent DNS management provides the same robust compatibility and automatic adaptation with enhanced privacy protection and seamless user experience.
